items.title: 68087_Cliff Leeman oral history interview
items.q: we played all the songs that they wanted... we went up there first, you spent the first night at his home and had a little jazz session there... Dick Gibson, and his World's Greatest Jazz Band... I worked there with Jack Lesberg... we worked there with such groups as Joe Venuti... and Buck Clayton

ctx.x: So Richard Gibson -- Dick Gibson has been giving jazz parties in Denver, in Aspen, and in Vail, Colorado, at the Broadmore Hotel, for how many years?
This will be the 17th year. Just count 17 from nine -- '62, I think.
